chunks: By this chain of transmission, from Ibrahim ibn al-Hakam, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Siyah, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Ata' ibn Yasar, from Aisha.
She said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said: Ammar ibn Yasir was never given a choice between two matters except that he chose the more challenging of them.

key_terms.أَشَدَّهُمَا: the more challenging of the two — indicating Ammar's habit of choosing the harder but more righteous option
key_terms.خُيِّرَ: was given a choice, placed before two options

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ammar ibn Yasir's character and choices?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated on the authority of Aisha, records the Prophet's praise of Ammar ibn Yasir's character. The Prophet testified that whenever Ammar was faced with two options, he consistently chose the harder, more demanding path. This saying highlights Ammar's exceptional dedication and willingness to sacrifice comfort for principle, and it would have served as further evidence of his righteousness during the turmoil following his death at Siffin.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ibrahim b. al-Hakam from `Ubaydullah b. Musa from `Abd al-`Aziz b. Sayyah from Habib b. Abi Thabit from `Ata’ b. Yasar from `A’isha.
She said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: `Ammar b. Yasir is not given a choice between two things except that he chooses the more challenging of them.
